sentence: وَشْلَونَك الْيَوم؟ عَسَاك طَيِّب يَا خُوي.
raw: وشلونك اليوم؟ عساك طيب يا خوي.
ipa: waʃˈlawnak alˈjawm ʕaˈsaːk ˈtˤɑjjib jaː ˈxuːj
gloss_en: How are you today? I hope you are well, brother.
notes: wišlōnak Najdi greeting (ingham1994 §greetings); xūy vocative

sentence: اَلْيَوم الْجَوّ بَارِد فِي الرِّيَاض وَالْغُبَار رَاح.
raw: اليوم الجو بارد في الرياض والغبار راح.
ipa: alˈjawm alˈdʒaww ˈbaːrid fiː rriˈjɑːðˤ walɣuˈbaːr ˈraːħ
gloss_en: Today the weather is cold in Riyadh and the dust has gone.
notes: ج=/dʒ/ (ingham1994; sedentary Najdi); sun assimilation ar-r; رَاح perfective

sentence: مَا أَبْغَى قَهْوَة، أَبْغَى شَاهِي أَحْمَر بَس.
raw: ما أبغى قهوة، أبغى شاهي أحمر بس.
ipa: maː ˈʔabɣaː ˈɡahawa ˈʔabɣaː ˈʃaːhiː ˈʔaħamar ˈbas
gloss_en: I don't want coffee, I only want red tea.
notes: abɣā (Najdi, ingham1994); ق=/ɡ/ gahwa (ingham1994 §consonants: Najdi g); šāhi 'tea'

sentence: اِشْتَرَيت ثَلَاث كَيلُوَات تَمَر مِن السُّوق بِخَمْسِين رِيَال.
raw: اشتريت ثلاث كيلوات تمر من السوق بخمسين ريال.
ipa: ʔiʃtaˈrajt θaˈlaːθ kajluˈwaːt ˈtamar min asˈsuːɡ bixamˈsiːn riˈjaːl
gloss_en: I bought three kilos of dates from the market for fifty riyals.
notes: ث retained /θ/ (ingham1994: Najdi interdental retention); ق=/ɡ/ sūg

sentence: هَاذَا الرَّجَّال يِذْكُر أَظْهَر مِن أَمْس الظُّهُر.
raw: هاذا الرجال يذكر أظهر من أمس الظهر.
ipa: ˈhaːðaː rradʒˈdʒaːl ˈjiðkur ˈʔɑðˤhar min ˈʔams ˈɑðˤðˤʊhur
gloss_en: This man remembers better than yesterday noon.
notes: ذ retained /ð/; ظ=/ðˤ/ retained (ingham1994); geminate جّ

sentence: يَا وَلَد، رُوح جِيب الْقَهْوَة حَقّ الضُّيُوف.
raw: يا ولد، روح جيب القهوة حق الضيوف.
ipa: jaː ˈwalad ˈruːħ ˈdʒiːb alˈɡahawa ˈħaɡɡ ɑðˤðˤʊˈjuːf
gloss_en: Boy, go bring the coffee for the guests.
notes: imperatives ruh/jib; gahawa-syndrome epenthesis surfaces in algahawa (ingham1994); hagg possessive; ض/ظ merger in the emphatic of duyuf

gloss_en: The weather today isn't hot.
notes: مُو negation (ingham1994); ج=/dʒ/, geminate جّ/رّ; diphthong يَو

gloss_en: How much is this thing? Twenty riyals.
notes: بِكَم→[bitsam]: /k/ after front /i/ affricates to [ts] (ingham1994 NAJD_AFFRIC_K_AFTER; almahmoud2020 ex.2); الشِّي 'the thing'; sun assim ش

gloss_en: The appointment is at five tomorrow.
notes: بُكْرَة 'tomorrow', مَوْعِد diphthong; sun assim السّاعة; five=number; Najdi vowel/consonant phonology per (ingham1994)

gloss_en: My family lives in Riyadh.
notes: أَهْل→[ʔahal] gahawa-syndrome epenthesis after guttural /h/ (ingham1994 pp.15-16 NAJD_GAHAWA_h); ض=/ðˤ/ emphatic backing

sentence: رُوح عَلَى طُول عُقُب لِفّ يَمِين.
raw: روح على طول عقب لف يمين.
ipa: ˈruːħ ˈʕalaː ˈtˤʊːl ˈʕuɡub ˈliff jaˈmiːn
gloss_en: Go straight, then turn right.
notes: عُقُب 'then/after' (ingham1994); ق=/ɡ/ عُقُب; imperatives رُوح/لِفّ; geminate فّ

gloss_en: The food was very delicious.
notes: الأَكِل→[ʔatsil]: /k/ before front /i/ affricates to [ts] (ingham1994; almahmoud2020 ex.1); مَرَّة intensifier 'very'; ذ retained /ð/

gloss_en: Where is the boy? He isn't here.
notes: وَيْن [wajn] diphthong RETAINED (Najdi, not Qassimi monophthong; ingham1994); هِنِي 'here'; مُو negation

gloss_en: How many kids do you have?
notes: عِيَال 'kids' (ingham1994); كَم quantity question; عِنْدَك pharyngeal ʕ

gloss_en: If you come tomorrow, I'll be happy.
notes: conditional إِذَا; جِيت 'you came' ج=/dʒ/; فَرْحَان 'happy'; بُكْرَة 'tomorrow'; Najdi consonant system (ǧīm [dʒ], qaf→[ɡ]) per (ingham1994)

gloss_en: I went to the market and bought meat.
notes: لَحْم→[laħam] gahawa epenthesis after guttural /ħ/ (ingham1994 pp.15-16); شَرَيْت 'bought' (avoids و+waṣl seam); ق=/ɡ/ سُوق; sun assim السّوق

gloss_en: I'll travel to Riyadh next week.
notes: بَـ future prefix (ingham1994); الْجَاي 'the coming/next' ج=/dʒ/; ض=/ðˤ/; sun assim الرّياض

gloss_en: Call me tonight, man.
notes: رَجَّال 'man' (ingham1994) geminate جّ; كَلِّمْنِي imperative geminate لّ; اللَّيْلَة diphthong

sentence: السَّلَام عَلَيْكُم يَا رَجَّال، وَعَلَيْكُم السَّلَام.
raw: السلام عليكم يا رجال، وعليكم السلام.
ipa: assaˈlaːm ʕaˈlajkum jaː radʒˈdʒaːl waʕaˈlajkum assaˈlaːm
gloss_en: Peace be upon you, man. And upon you, peace.
notes: greeting adjacency pair; رَجَّال (ingham1994); sun assim السّلام; عَلَيْكُم pharyngeal + diphthong

gloss_en: He who doesn't know the falcon grills it.
notes: proverb; الصَّقِر→[sˤɑdzir]: ق=/ɡ/ then /ɡ/ before front /i/ affricates to [dz] (ingham1994; almahmoud2020 ex.10); مَا negation; sun assim الصّقر
